name: A Maze'N Things
bio_draft: maze, mini-golf, illusions hall and adventure ropes course at Phillip Island Road.

name: French Island
bio_draft: Western Port island with national park, koalas and waterbirds, reached by passenger ferry from Stony Point or Cowes.

name: State Coal Mine
bio_draft: former coal mine museum at Wonthaggi, run by Parks Victoria, with underground tours.

name: Meeting of the Waters
bio_draft: Riverside park viewpoint at Wentworth where the Murray and Darling rivers meet, about 20 km west of Mildura.

name: Australian Inland Botanic Gardens
bio_draft: Semi-arid botanic gardens at Buronga, near Mildura, with plants from every inhabited continent and native species.

name: Apex Park
bio_draft: Riverside park on the Murray at Mildura with a sandbar swimming beach, sometimes patrolled.
